answer: Test it like a feature, not like a slogan. Draw each jury from three distinct networks and rotate the pool every epoch. One concrete example: a seat held by the same operator for 30 days is expired, so it must be re-earned with fresh receipts. A kernel of reputation is not a lifetime title. The pearl is that a farm must keep producing work to keep a seat, and the relic of an old score earns nothing on its own.
